description: 休日の大型水族館で、3人の高校生が巨大な水槽を見学している。中央では男子生徒が水槽の案内パネルを見ながら魚の種類を調べ、ノートに気づいたことを書いている。左側の女子生徒はスマートフォンで大きなエイと魚の群れを撮影している。右側の女子生徒は水槽の近くにあるデジタル展示画面を操作し、海洋生物の生息環境について調べている。巨大水槽にはエイ、ウミガメ、色鮮やかな魚の群れが泳ぎ、岩、サンゴ、水草なども見える。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three teenage students visiting a large modern aquarium in Japan. Do not include any additional visible people. The atmosphere should be calm, fascinating, educational, and positive. The main visual feature must be a huge floor-to-ceiling aquarium tank filled with clear blue water. Inside the tank, show one large stingray swimming gracefully near the center, one sea turtle moving through the middle distance, and a clearly visible school of colorful tropical fish. Include rocks, coral, aquatic plants, bubbles, and soft underwater light rays. In the center foreground, a teenage boy wearing casual clothes and a small backpack is standing beside an aquarium information panel. He is reading the panel carefully and writing observations in a small notebook with a pen. On the left side, a teenage girl is holding a smartphone horizontally and taking a photograph of the large stingray and the school of fish. She should look impressed and excited by the view. On the right side, another teenage girl is using a touchscreen educational display beside the aquarium tank. The display should show simple visual icons of the ocean, coral reef, fish, temperature, and habitat, without important readable text. She is pointing at the screen and appears to be learning about marine habitats. Make the three activities visually distinct and easy to describe: one student reading and taking notes, one photographing sea life, and one using an interactive educational display. Include a notebook, pen, smartphone, backpack, information panel, interactive touchscreen, aquarium rail, blue ambient lighting, and reflections from the water. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Exactly three visible people. No additional people, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters, and no text required to understand the scene. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, highly detailed but visually organized and uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

sentences.text: The three students are exploring an immersive aquarium exhibit that illustrates the biodiversity of a marine ecosystem.
sentences.ja: 3人の生徒は海洋生態系の生物多様性を示す没入型の水族館展示を見学しています。

sentences.text: The male student is consulting an information panel while documenting his observations in a notebook.
sentences.ja: 男子生徒は案内パネルを参照しながら、観察した内容をノートに記録しています。

sentences.text: He appears to be identifying and categorizing some of the species visible in the tank.
sentences.ja: 彼は水槽内に見える生き物の種類を特定し、分類しているようです。

sentences.text: One of his companions is using her smartphone to capture a large stingray as it glides past the viewing window.
sentences.ja: 同行者の一人は、大きなエイが観察窓の前を滑るように泳ぐ様子をスマートフォンで撮影しています。

sentences.text: Her expression suggests that she is captivated by the scale and graceful movement of the animal.
sentences.ja: 彼女の表情から、その生き物の大きさと優雅な動きに魅了されていることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, the third student is investigating marine habitats through an interactive educational display.
sentences.ja: その一方で、3人目の生徒は体験型の教育展示を使って海洋生物の生息環境を調べています。

sentences.text: The sea turtle, stingray, and large school of fish demonstrate the diversity of species occupying the simulated habitat.
sentences.grammar: 現在分詞による後置修飾
sentences.ja: ウミガメ、エイ、大きな魚の群れが、再現された生息環境に暮らす生物の多様性を示しています。

sentences.text: The combination of direct observation and digital information allows the students to investigate the ecosystem from several perspectives.
sentences.ja: 直接観察とデジタル情報を組み合わせることで、生徒たちは複数の視点から生態系を調べることができます。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how a recreational visit can also provide opportunities to learn about biodiversity, habitats, and marine conservation.
sentences.ja: この場面は、レジャーとしての訪問でも、生物多様性、生息環境、海洋保全について学ぶ機会になり得ることを示しています。
